types/utils.ts/Overwrite: only overwrite keys of objects

Overwrite<string,string> resulted in a mangled object type
because the existing implementation iterated over the string
type's keys (e.g. 'charCodeAt')

This commit changes the implementation so that keys are only
iterated and overwritten in the case of objects. Otherwise,
a non-never TWith type will entirely replace TType, e.g.
Overwrite<string, number> results in 'number'.

summary.intent: Fix `inferRouterInputs`/`inferRouterOutputs` for procedures that chain `.use()` after `.input(z.string())`, by making the internal `Overwrite` type replace non-object types instead of mapping over their keys (supplied PR title and commit `7dc04a7e`).
summary.issue_fit: Partial — the supplied PR text and commit message are met for string inputs, but the rewritten `Overwrite` regresses `any`-typed context.
summary.coverage: Both changed files reviewed at the pinned range; focused `tsc` runs at head and merge-base; the untracked `.mcp.json` in the clone is uncommitted and not reviewed.

Reviewer type-checked the new regression test against merge-base sources in a scratch config: the two `toBeString()` assertions on `strWithMiddleware` fail there, so the test discriminates the fix.

findings.title: Keep Overwrite a single object type when TType is any
findings.trigger: A router built on `initTRPC.context<any>()` adds context in a middleware, for example `t.procedure.use((opts) => opts.next({ ctx: { extra: 1 } })).query(({ ctx }) => ctx.foo.bar)`.
findings.impact: `any` distributes into both branches of the new `TType extends object` test, so ctx becomes a union with the non-indexable `{ extra: number }` and `ctx.foo` fails with TS2339, where the merge-base compiled cleanly.
findings.change: In `Overwrite`, test for `any` first (for example `0 extends 1 & TType`) and keep the key-by-key mapped type for that case, then add an `initTRPC.context<any>()` middleware case to `packages/tests/server/regression/issue-5020-inference-middleware.test.ts`.

findings.title: Drop the unreachable `TType` fallback in Overwrite
findings.trigger: `TWith extends any` on line 26 is true for every type, and for `never` the distributive conditional yields `never` before reaching the `: TType` arm, so `Overwrite<string, never>` is `never`, not `string`.
findings.impact: The doc comment says a non-object `TType` is overwritten "unless TWith is never", which suggests `Overwrite<X, never>` keeps `X`, and the dead arm reinforces that misreading.
findings.change: Collapse the non-object arm to `TWith` and reword the doc comment to say that a `never` `TWith` yields `never`.

observations.fact: The new test declares `voidWithMiddleware` but never asserts on it, leaves two `// ^?` editor markers, and covers only a string input, not number, array, union or object inputs.

requirements.evidence: `packages/tests/server/regression/issue-5020-inference-middleware.test.ts:29-38` fails its `toBeString()` assertions against merge-base sources and type-checks clean at head.

`packages/server/src/core/internals/utils.ts:11-30` returns `TWith` for non-object `TType`; scratch probe shows `Overwrite<string,string>` is `string`. Compliance is met; compatibility is violated for `any` context, see server/overwrite-any-context-union.
